journey.name: receive amount survives backgrounding
journey.description: Verifies that an edited Receive amount and note stay on the request when the app goes to the background and returns while the Receive sheet stays open, that the invoice shown after returning is a new one for the same amount, and that closing the sheet resets the request. Requires a running Lightning node or a connected Spark wallet that can issue a 4 000 sat invoice. Read the QR contents with Copy (testTag "ReceiveCopyQR") and decode the Lightning invoice; a screenshot of a loading placeholder alone does not establish a failure. This journey is pending device validation.

actions.action: Launch Bitkit, tap Receive (testTag "Receive") and verify the Receive sheet is visible (testTag "ReceiveScreen")
Select Auto, tap Edit (testTag "SpecifyInvoiceButton"), enter 4 000 sats, type the note "coffee" (testTag "ReceiveNote") and tap Show QR Code (testTag "ShowQrReceive")
Wait for the QR code (testTag "QRCode") to finish loading, copy its URI and verify it contains amount=0.00004, message=coffee and a lightning invoice of 4 000 sats; keep the invoice
Run adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME and wait 10 seconds
Run adb shell am start -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.ui.MainActivity and verify the Receive sheet is still visible (testTag "ReceiveScreen")
Wait for the QR code to finish loading, copy its URI and verify it still contains amount=0.00004 and message=coffee
Verify the lightning invoice in the URI is for 4 000 sats, is not expired and differs from the invoice kept before backgrounding
Tap Edit and verify the amount shows 4 000 sats and the note shows "coffee"
Clear the amount to 0, tap Show QR Code, then repeat the KEYCODE_HOME and am start steps
Wait for the QR code to finish loading and verify its URI has no fixed amount and its lightning invoice is amountless
Tap Edit, enter 4 000 sats again and tap Show QR Code; close the Receive sheet and open Receive again
Wait for the QR code to finish loading and verify its URI has no amount and no message, its lightning invoice is amountless, and Edit shows an empty amount and note
